name: Golden Key
location: Under the pillow on the bed.
acquisition_hint: The bed and pillow are interactable; inspect the pillow instead of only looking around the room.
uses: Unlocks a previously locked drawer in the desk.

name: Power Cord
location: Inside a drawer unlocked with the golden key.
acquisition_hint: Use the key found under the pillow on the locked drawer.
uses: Powers the stereo on top of the desk.

name: Screwdriver
location: Collected later after the room's puzzles are solved.
acquisition_hint: The source verifies that the screwdriver is obtained near the end, but this database does not yet include every prerequisite puzzle.
uses: Used on the locked door's doorknob to escape.

name: Pillow
acquisition_hint: Not an inventory item; lifting it reveals the golden key.

name: Stereo
acquisition_hint: It needs power before it can be used.
uses: Can be powered with the power cord and turned on.
